headline: MARIO CELEBRATES HIS 40TH BIRTHDAY
body: @marioworldwide turned 40 on Thursday, August 27, marking the milestone with a first-party post about fatherhood and his seven-month-old son. The Baltimore singer first broke through as a teenager and built a two-decade R&B run around records including 'Just a Friend 2002' and 'Let Me Love You.' His birthday arrives while he is promoting the Mood Swings EP and new dates on The R&B Tour.
